line_evidence.text: A3.3.3 Explain how SQL can be used to update data in a database.
• Insert new records (INSERT INTO), modify data (UPDATE SET), remove data (DELETE)
• The performance implications of updating data in indexed columns, and how indexes might need to
be rebuilt or reorganized following significant data modifications
